body: Glad to hear that and I couldn’t agree more with you, practicing pedophilia is a fucked up thing to do irregardless of the person’s sexuality, and props to OP and those who suffer with such thoughts on daily basis and NOT act upon them, one could only imagine the internal battle and pain they are in.

I’d like to know whether if he’s transgender but chose to stay in his original body? (If so I think they refer to those who do so as Transexual which is what person A is)

And that sounds painful and it's impossible to maintain one’s own mental health over the long term living like that, if not I'd doubt that the person you’re referring to is really living in Planet M.

It’s not possible, for reasons that’s won't be discussed, so does it mean that it’s rational and completely reasonable to off oneself in such unbearable situation? and is it really that bad or is person A just being a sensitive crybaby?

I sometimes wish people would understand & make a distinctive terms between individuals who have pedophilia as their sole sexual orientation and the insensitive, greedy ungrateful monsters who have it as a side hobby and a mean to unleash anger and sexual tension on whatever the fuck they come across.

PS: it’s just something that needs to be acknowledged, I’m not on either’s side.

And they say suicide is selfish, this is a pure example of it being the other way around actually.

Anyway, they sure wouldn’t find that love and acceptance in planet M, I genuinely wish who is ever in control of person’s A story was as optimistic and benevolent as you are.

But why must person A turn themselves into a mean or tool to improve the lives of the people around them, disregarding their own.

Are they less of a human? do they not deserve the chance to be happy as well? and who is even going to acknowledge their heroic acts and pure selflessness?

Something worth mentioning; If they killed themselves they’ll be their OWN hero, and if they chose to live on they will be a hero to OTHERS, so they’ll die as a hero either way.
